title: Chapter 743 - 743 Meeting Kathleen Again; Secret Realm!
content:
Chapter 743 - 743 Meeting Kathleen Again; Secret Realm!

Chapter 743 - 743 Meeting Kathleen Again; Secret Realm!

743 Meeting Kathleen Again; Secret Realm!

Before cultivating, Lin Fan did not forget to curse Tai Ba.

After all, after breaking through, he had been cursing Bo Han, but he hadn’t cursed him for being too overbearing and not favoring one over the other.

Following that, Lin Fan willed himself into the River of Time.

He was in metal, wood, water, fire, earth… He continued to move forward on the Great Dao of the various elements.

It had to be said that Lin Fan was really strong right now. He was like an illusion on the paths of the various elements, advancing at high speed. He walked for 500,000 meters without feeling too much pressure.

On the main path of life, when Lin Fan reached 80,000 meters, his body suddenly stopped.

Because he saw a beauty with fair skin.

It was Kathleen.

At this moment, Kailin also noticed Lin Fan.

Her beautiful eyes were filled with unconcealable surprise.

“Lin Fan?”

“It’s me.” Lin Fan smiled.

“This… You actually walked all the way here?” Kathleen was still in disbelief.

The first time he saw Lin Fan was decades ago.

A few decades was just a blink of an eye for a King level expert like Kathleen.

In the blink of an eye, Lin Fan had gone from a thousand meters to 80,000 meters?

This… This was simply like a dream.

” Lin Fan,” Kathleen couldn’t help but say,” Did you only show off your weak power on purpose?””

It was no wonder that she had such thoughts.

Lin Fan’s improvement was simply too fast.

Lin Fan smiled,” You guess?”

“You gave me two opportunities, so I’ll return one to you now.”

After saying that, he raised his hand and gently pointed at Kathleen’s glabella.

“Whoosh!”

A ray of golden light entered Kathleen’s body.

Suddenly, an extremely mysterious life cultivation technique surged into Kathleen’s mind.

This… This was the Imperial skill that Lin Fan had obtained from the system, Revival.

After an unknown period of time, Kathleen slowly opened her eyes.

However, where was Lin Fan’s figure on the Great Dao of Life?

She could only say in her heart, Thank you.”

At this moment, Lin Fan had already returned to the Coiling Dragon Villa.

[Ding! [Kathleen’s favorability towards you has increased to 8 stars.]]

Seeing this, Lin Fan nodded his head and thought,” Not only was this woman beautiful, but she also knew how to be grateful. Not bad.

Then, he closed his eyes and entered his bitter cultivation.

After advancing to Emperor level, Lin Fan had obtained 2 Great Dao Fragments and 5 Saint Crystals from the system. This had allowed the Spirit Qi on Earth to reach a new peak. At the same time, it had also increased the comprehension of all living beings towards the Great Dao.

This caused Lin Fan’s cultivation state to grow even faster.

….

On the other hand.

33 Heavens.

Tai Ba, who was originally sitting cross-legged, suddenly emitted a faint black aura.

“Humph!”

Tai Ba grunted, his expression turning extremely ugly.

“The curse has become stronger!”

“Damn it! Who is the one cursing!”

His pupils moved slightly, and figures appeared in his mind.

Then, his figure flashed and he disappeared from where he was.

….

Time passed in cultivation. In the blink of an eye, 100 years had passed.

In these 100 years, the Four Seasons Cosmos had taken back the Spring Region and Summer Region, and it was developing in a good direction.

As for the once prosperous ocean universe, it became extremely chaotic and was invaded and divided by a large number of people.

In fact, it no longer had the name of the ocean universe.

I have to say, it’s fate.

….

At this moment, in front of an ancient stone wall.

A large group of men and women with powerful auras gathered together, but they were wary of each other.

If Lin Fan was here, two of them would definitely kneel down in excitement.

Because they were Ma Zheng and Li Ke.

However, the two of them did not know each other, so they did not have the intention to greet each other.

“Whoosh!”

In the next moment, a seven-colored light suddenly appeared on the ancient stone wall.

Everyone’s expression turned solemn as they rushed in.

This was the Ancient Mystic Realm! Someone had once become a King or Emperor in a day here. Someone had once obtained a powerful weapon. Someone had once obtained a heaven-defying cultivation technique…

This place…It contained countless monstrous opportunities.

After everyone entered, the ancient stone wall returned to its original appearance.

It was at this moment that Lin Fan, who was in the midst of his cultivation, heard a crisp notification in his mind.

[Ding! Mission failed, entering the Ancient Mystic Realm. Obtained Great Dao Fragment x1, Saint King Level Cultivation Technique Upgrade Gem x1, Transcendence Golden Body x5.]

Lin Fan opened his eyes slowly with a weird look on his face.

Mission?

When did the mission appear?

He didn’t seem to know.

The reward after failure seemed pretty good!

He placed his attention on the Saint King Grade Cultivation Method Upgrade Gem.

[Saint King Level Cultivation Technique Upgrade Gem: After use, it can upgrade a Holy Lord Level Cultivation Technique to a Saint King Level Cultivation Technique.]

Seeing this, Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

Saint King Grade cultivation technique!

He didn’t have any Saint King Level cultivation techniques.

This was definitely a good treasure!

Above the Saint Lord-level cultivation technique was the Saint King-level cultivation technique.

In other words, Saint Kings were above the Holy Lord Realm?

Lin Fan’s face revealed a thoughtful look.

After a while, Lin Fan turned his attention back to the Curse Technique.

In his opinion, curses were the most useful cultivation techniques.

Even if he stayed on Earth, he could still kill his enemies without anyone knowing.

[Do you want to use the Saint King Level Cultivation Technique Upgrade Gem on the Curse Spell?]

“Yes, sir!”

[Ding! Upgrade successful. Current Curse Skill: Saint King Level. The number of curses increased to 10 per day.]

The number of curses had increased!

Finally, it wasn’t once a day!

Seeing this…

Lin Fan smiled.

If he was happy, he naturally had to celebrate!

Hence, he decided to do it.

Lin Fan cursed Tai Ba x10.

Then, Lin Fan turned his attention to the system panel.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Level 4 Emperor-tier]

[Skills: Sword 81 (Emperor-level), Curse Technique (Saint King-level), Sword Nurturing Technique (Holy Lord-level), Universe Sword Technique (Emperor-level)…]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword (Overlord-tier), Flame Armor (Sacred Lord-tier), Heavenly Soul Bead (Overlord-tier), True Dragon Sword (Sacred Lord-tier)…]

[Laws: Time (Intermediate), Space (Advanced), Metal (Advanced), Wood (Advanced), Water (Advanced), Fire (Advanced), Earth (Advanced), Life (Advanced), Death (Advanced), Yin (Advanced), Yang (Advanced), Wind (Advanced)]

[Character Relationship:

Lin Tao, Daddy, Favorability: 10 stars;

[Dai Weixue: Mom, favorability rating of 10 stars.]

Lin Xiaoyao, Sister, Favorability: 10 stars;

Xia Xue: Dao Companion, Favorability 10 stars;

[Xia Bing: Dao Companion, Favorability: 10 stars…]

Level 4 Martial Monarch Realm cultivation!

In a hundred years, he had broken through from the first level of the Imperial level to the fourth level of the Imperial level. This speed of advancement was truly shocking!

However, Lin Fan wasn’t too excited about this speed.

He immediately turned his attention to Kathleen.

At this moment, Kathleen’s name kept flashing.

This meant that she was in danger!
